title: skip the UI pass or say "no TUI views changed" in the brief when the diff touches only CLI test strings and docs, no internal/tui or golden files

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
S450 was filed as tool feedback. An ork run on S432 changed only `internal/cli` test strings and docs. `sliceTouchesUI` counts a slice's `internal/cli` paths as UI (`internal/engine/states.go:840-858`), so the UI pass ran. Its brief still demanded renders and the role had to rule that out by hand. S540, merged in here, reported the other side. S261 changed only CLI text, which does not depend on width, and the role wrote 15 identical files for 5 views.

The owner decided this (adj 643, `ui.pass-cli-scope`, 2026-11-27, "Note + S540 rule"):
- The UI pass still runs. When the diff, with `.slicer/` and `landed-changed/` paths skipped (adj 600), changes only `_test.go` files under `internal/cli` and `docs/*.md`, the UI brief gets a "No renders expected" section and a matching Done-when item, as S584 did for `internal/tui` tests (`internal/engine/states.go:864-876`, `internal/engine/brief.go:456-463`).
- When the diff changes only CLI output (`internal/cli` non-test files or goldens, plus docs), the UI brief says the 80x24, 120x40 and ascii renders are identical. The role then writes one file per view.

Owner decision, 2026-11-27: adj 643.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/states.go:610-633` (`review` picks the section for the UI round; new helpers `onlyCLITestAndDocFiles` and `cliOutputOnly` beside `onlyTUITestFiles` at `:864`)
- `internal/engine/brief.go:335-337` (new title constants `uiNoRendersCLITitle` and `uiIdenticalRendersTitle`)
- `internal/engine/brief.go:456-463` (`doneWhen`, the `RoleUI` case, adds the CLI wording)
- `internal/engine/uipass_test.go:866-986` (new tests beside the S584 tests; the file exists)
- `docs/design.md:854-862` (the "No renders expected" paragraph states the new rules)
- `landed-changed/S450.md` (new)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
All in `internal/engine/uipass_test.go`.
- TestOnlyCLITestAndDocFiles: a table for `onlyCLITestAndDocFiles(paths []string) bool`.
  - True for `internal/cli/x_test.go`, for `internal/cli/sub/x_test.go`, for `docs/design.md`, for `internal/cli/x_test.go` with `docs/design.md`, and for `.slicer/index.json`, `landed-changed/S1.md` and `internal/cli/x_test.go` (adj 600).
  - False for an empty list, for tracking paths only, for `internal/cli/status.go`, for `internal/cli/testdata/golden/x.txt`, for `internal/tui/x_test.go`, for `internal/engine/x_test.go`, for `internal/cli2/x_test.go`, for `docs/sub/x.md`, for `README.md`, and for `internal/cli/x_test.go` with `internal/cli/status.go`.
- TestCLIOutputOnly: a table for `cliOutputOnly(paths []string) bool`.
  - True for `internal/cli/status.go`, for `internal/cli/testdata/golden/x.txt`, for `internal/cli/status.go` with `internal/cli/x_test.go`, for `internal/cli/status.go` with `docs/design.md`, and for the same with tracking paths added.
  - False for an empty list, for tracking paths only, for `internal/cli/x_test.go` only, for `docs/design.md` only, for `internal/cli/status.go` with `internal/tui/model.go`, for `internal/cli/status.go` with `internal/engine/x.go`, and for `internal/cli2/status.go`.
- TestUIPassBriefSaysNoRendersWhenOnlyCLITestsAndDocsChanged: the slice's Files names `internal/cli/x_test.go` and `docs/design.md`, and the routed diff is the same two paths. The UI brief holds `## No renders expected` and a Done-when item that says no renders are expected for CLI test files and docs and none are to be written. It holds no Done-when item starting "Produce the required renders", and its Done-when item still holds "Complete sections (A)-(D)". The reviewer's brief holds neither.
- TestUIPassBriefSaysRendersAreIdenticalWhenOnlyCLIOutputChanged: the slice's Files names `internal/cli/status.go` and `internal/cli/testdata/golden/status.txt`, and the routed diff includes those and `internal/cli/status_test.go`. The UI brief holds `## Renders are identical at every size`. It says the 80x24, 120x40 and ascii renders of a view are identical and the role writes one file per view, named `VIEW-80x24.txt`, with no `VIEW-120x40.txt` or `VIEW-ascii.txt`. It still holds the "Produce the required renders" Done-when item and no "No renders expected" section. The reviewer's brief holds neither.
- TestUIPassBriefKeepsRendersWhenCLIAndTUIChanged: the routed diff is `internal/cli/status.go` and `internal/tui/model.go`. The UI brief has neither new section and still has the "Produce the required renders" Done-when item.
- TestUIPassBriefHasNoCLISectionsWhenTheDiffCannotBeRead: the Files names `internal/cli/x_test.go`, and the routed `git diff` exits 1. The UI pass runs once, its brief has neither new section, and the run reaches awaiting approval.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the six tests first (names under Failing tests) and see them fail. Build each harness with `noRendersHarness` (`uipass_test.go:897`) and `briefsOf` (`:919`), which already route the slicer show, merge-base, diff and ls-files calls.
2. In `internal/engine/brief.go`, beside `uiNoRendersTitle` (`:337`), add `const uiNoRendersCLITitle = "No renders expected for CLI tests and docs"` and `const uiIdenticalRendersTitle = "Renders are identical at every size"`. The first keeps the `No renders expected` prefix of the S584 section.
3. In `internal/engine/states.go`, beside `onlyTUITestFiles` (`:864`), add `onlyCLITestAndDocFiles(paths []string) bool`. It skips paths starting `.slicer/` or `landed-changed/` (adj 600) and is true only when at least one path is left and every path left is either a `_test.go` file under `internal/cli/` or a `.md` file directly under `docs/`.
4. Beside it add `cliOutputOnly(paths []string) bool`. It skips the same tracking paths. It is true only when every path left is under `internal/cli/` or is a `.md` file directly under `docs/`, and at least one path left is under `internal/cli/` and does not end in `_test.go`. Leave `onlyTUITestFiles` unchanged.
5. In `review` (`internal/engine/states.go:628-630`), replace the single `if` with a switch on the paths from `e.branchPaths(ctx, rec)`. On a `branchPaths` error add nothing and do not pause (S584).
   - `onlyTUITestFiles(paths)`: add the S584 section as it is.
   - else `onlyCLITestAndDocFiles(paths)`: add a `BriefSection{Title: uiNoRendersCLITitle, ...}`. Its body says the diff changes only `_test.go` files under `internal/cli` and docs, so no view or golden file changed, no renders are expected, write no files in the renders directory, and say so in the report naming the changed files, writing "nothing" for each empty section.
   - else `cliOutputOnly(paths)`: add a `BriefSection{Title: uiIdenticalRendersTitle, ...}`. Its body says the diff changes only CLI output, which does not depend on terminal width, so the 80x24, 120x40 and ascii renders of a view are identical. Write one file per view, `VIEW-80x24.txt`, and no `VIEW-120x40.txt` or `VIEW-ascii.txt`. Say in the report that the sizes are identical.
6. In `doneWhen`, in the `RoleUI` case (`internal/engine/brief.go:456-463`), also check for a section titled `uiNoRendersCLITitle`. When it is there, replace the "Produce the required renders..." text with: "No renders are expected: the diff changes only CLI test files and docs. Write no render files and say so in your report." Keep the S584 wording for `uiNoRendersTitle`, and leave the item as it is for `uiIdenticalRendersTitle`. Keep the rest of the item, from "Complete sections (A)-(D)" on.
7. In `docs/design.md`, in the "No renders expected" paragraph (`:854-862`), add that a diff whose paths are all `_test.go` files under `internal/cli` and `docs/*.md` gets the same section and Done-when item (adj 643). Add that a diff that changes only `internal/cli` output and docs adds a "Renders are identical at every size" section, so the role writes one `VIEW-80x24.txt` for each view, and that any other diff leaves the brief as it is.
8. Run `slicer changelog add S450 --text "..." --root /home/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork` for the changelog entry. Do not edit `CHANGELOG.md`. Do not change `internal/roles/prompts/ui.md`, the goldens or the approval card; the card already sorts a lone `VIEW-80x24.txt` (`internal/engine/approval.go:549-559`).
9. Run `go -C /home/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork test ./internal/engine`, then the checks under Check.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- A UI round whose diff, with tracking paths skipped, is only _test.go files under internal/cli and docs/*.md has a brief with a "No renders expected" section and a Done-when item that says no renders are expected.
- A UI round whose diff is only internal/cli output changes and docs (at least one non-test internal/cli path) has a brief that says the three renders are identical and asks for one VIEW-80x24.txt for each view. The renders Done-when item stays.
- A diff with any other path, or no readable diff, gets neither new section. The reviewer's brief never gets either.
- The S584 behavior for internal/tui test-only diffs is unchanged.

Commands:
- `go test -run TestOnlyCLITestAndDocFiles ./internal/engine` exits 0 and all its subtests pass.
- `go test -run TestCLIOutputOnly ./internal/engine` exits 0 and all its subtests pass.
- `go test -run TestUIPassBriefSaysNoRendersWhenOnlyCLITestsAndDocsChanged ./internal/engine` exits 0.
- `go test -run TestUIPassBriefSaysRendersAreIdenticalWhenOnlyCLIOutputChanged ./internal/engine` exits 0.
- `go test -run TestUIPassBriefKeepsRendersWhenCLIAndTUIChanged ./internal/engine` exits 0.
- `go test -run TestUIPassBriefHasNoCLISectionsWhenTheDiffCannotBeRead ./internal/engine` exits 0.
- `go test -run TestOnlyTUITestFiles ./internal/engine` exits 0 (S584 table unchanged).
- `go test ./internal/engine` exits 0.
- `go test ./...` exits 0.
- `go vet ./...` exits 0.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
- [HUMAN CHECK] On the next slice whose diff is only internal/cli _test.go files and docs, open the ui role's brief in the run directory. It should hold ## No renders expected for CLI tests and docs and no "Produce the required renders" Done-when item. On the next slice that changes CLI output text, the UI brief should hold ## Renders are identical at every size, and the role should write one VIEW-80x24.txt for each view.
